title: Arrival Window Guarantee Terms for Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
## Terms in force

- **The guarantee.** In call classes of Repair and Emergency Service Calls whose on-time credit is above $0.00, Harbison guarantees arrival within the booked window.
- **One credit per call.** Only one on-time credit is posted per call. Whether a call already carries one is read from that call's invoice lines.
- **No credit.** A call the customer rescheduled after dispatch earns no credit. Neither does a call delayed because the customer asked the technician to come later.
- **Response guarantee.** This credit is separate from, and may be earned together with, a Comfort Club response-guarantee credit.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The former clause under which the on-time credit was earned only when the technician arrived more than the class's late-arrival grace minutes after the end of the booked arrival window is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current on-time credit basis.
- The former clause setting the credit at the class's on-time credit figure, posted against the visit's diagnostic fee line and able to reduce the invoice below the diagnostic fee but never below zero, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current on-time credit basis.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | On-time credit |
|---|---|
| Call class whose on-time credit is $0.00 (no on-time guarantee) | None |
| Call already carries an on-time credit | No second credit |
| Customer rescheduled the call after dispatch | None |
| Customer asked the technician to come later | None |
| Member also earned a Comfort Club response-guarantee credit | Both may be earned |

superseded_clauses: the on-time credit is earned only when the technician arrived more than late_arrival_grace_minutes minutes after the end of the booked arrival window
The credit is late_arrival_credit_usd, posted as a late_arrival_credit naming the visit's diagnostic fee line, and it may reduce the invoice below the diagnostic fee but never below zero.
